raj (sdk): heads-up — weird TS overload inference when bundling for Edge. works in CJS, breaks in ESM build.
raj (sdk): example:
```ts
export function fetchThing(id: string): Promise<string>;
export function fetchThing(opts: { id: string; raw: true }): Promise<Uint8Array>;
export function fetchThing(arg: any) { /* impl */ }
```
raj (sdk): in Node (cjs) callers pick correct overload, in edge build TS chooses the first overload always.
olivia (ts-typing): yeah i've seen that with isolatedModules + moduleResolution set to bundler. can you share tsconfig?
maria (devex): also saw similar with esbuild + declaration emit differences. tiny repro helps.
raj (sdk): tsconfig:
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "declaration": true,
    "emitDeclarationOnly": true,
    "isolatedModules": true
  }
}
```
raj (sdk): minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/anon/abcd1234 (contains package.json + build script using esbuild)
olivia (ts-typing): isolatedModules + emitDeclarationOnly is a common combo that can make d.ts generation lose overload ordering. TS sometimes collapses overloads when it can't rely on full program emit.
emma (sdk): practical workaround: export a single generic overload with a discriminant instead of multiple overloads. eg: `fetchThing<T extends boolean = false>(opts: T extends true ? { id: string; raw: true } : string): Promise<T extends true ? Uint8Array : string>`
maria (devex): long term we should ensure our SDK build pipeline emits consistent .d.ts across ESM/CJS bundles. this might affect onboard samples and downstream TS consumers.
raj (sdk): thanks emma — that pattern works for my app. but it's noisy for public API. can we adjust build flags?
olivia (ts-typing): try moduleResolution: "node16" or remove isolatedModules for the declaration build step. also ensure `declarationMap` off.
raj (sdk): changing moduleResolution to node16 + running `tsc -p tsconfig.declarations.json` fixed the overload order in the emitted .d.ts for my repro.
emma (sdk): nice. can you file an issue with before/after d.ts and the tiny repro? tag sdk-team + eng-platform.
raj (sdk): created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2345 — added repro and suggested build change. cc @maria @olivia
ci-bot: created issue #2345 by raj (sdk) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2345 :robot_face:
maria (devex): thanks — i'll add to the SDK migration checklist for new templates.
olivia (ts-typing): we should also document edge-runtime caveats in the README: recommended tsconfig for declaration emits.
raj (sdk): will update sample apps after the merge. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
